transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?
What brings me in is, if I think there might be a bat or something flapping around the stockroom, my heart just jumps. I start sweating and feel like I need to get out of there right away.
Do these episodes of a racing heart and sweating ever happen out of the blue, in situations where there's no bat or flying creature around at all?
No, it’s not out of the blue. It happens right when I think there could be a bat or something flying around—then my heart starts racing and I just want to get out.
